input: Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_g8.text must also be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to knight_g8's own key, and every commit that modifies any /moves/<agent>.text path must also modify /turn/ply.num in the same commit.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_g8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false)
